messages:
Alonzo Vega: Hey team — Alonzo here, joining eng-ml as Inference Engineer! First day ✅. Quick setup asks: MDM shows my laptop as 'Pending', and I can't sudo into dev boxes. Also need GPU access for a 3090 node for early experiments. Who should I ping? Also very excited to meet y'all :wave: Fun fact: I bake sourdough.
Tara (People Ops): Welcome, Alonzo!! :tada: I'll check MDM status. Can you DM me the device serial and your preferred shipping address for a welcome kit? Your buddy is Sam — he'll help with infra and access.
Sam Wells: hey Alonzo — welcome aboard :rocket: Send me your GitHub handle and corp email and I'll add you to inference-dev and request GPU quota. For sudo, paste the exact error you see (that helps).
Alonzo Vega: Error is `permission denied, user is not in sudoers file`. GitHub: alonzov. Corp email: alonzo@redwood.com. Device serial: C02XJ1234K7P. Thanks!
Riley (DevEx): @Sam noted. Quick tip for MDM enrolment: try re-enrolling using https://mdm.redwood.com/enroll and run `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` on mac. If it still says Pending, reply here with "enroll-resend" and MDM Bot will resend the invite.
MDM Bot: Enrollment re-send scheduled for device C02XJ1234K7P. You will receive an invite email in ~5 minutes. If you do not, open a ticket in #help and tag `@Tara (People Ops)`.
Sam Wells: Done — added you to the `inference-dev` GCP project and filed GPU quota request (ticket #7881). Also added `alonzov` to the `wheel` group; try `sudo -v` and then run a simple command that needs sudo.
Alonzo Vega: sudo works now \:raised_hands: Got the MDM invite and enrolled. Thanks Sam/Tara/Riley! One more: who do I ping for a dev box with CUDA drivers if the GCP quota is slow?
Sam Wells: If quota is delayed ping `#eng-ml` and tag me. We have a couple of spare nodes in the dedicated pool for bootstrapping — I'll reserve one if needed.
Riley (DevEx): Also FYI: our benchmark starter scripts live at `git@github.com:redwood/benchmarks` — there's a `starter/` folder with quick examples and a `run_baseline.sh` you can copy. Welcome again and see you at the sync!
Alonzo Vega: Awesome. Would love a quick 20–30m intro with the team — I'm generally free afternoons PST.
Sam Wells: Let's do 3pm PST tomorrow. I'll send a calendar invite. Also expect a sticker pack in the mail :stuck_out_tongue_closed_eyes:
Tara (People Ops): Added to the "first week check-in" doc and put you on the onboarding rotation for mentor pairing. Ping me if anything else blocks you. :coffee:
